candidate_claims.statement: The letter was transmitted to the President under cover of a memorandum dated March 5, 1945, from William J. Donovan, Director of the Office of Strategic Services.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: This letter was transmitted to the President under cover of a memorandum dated March 5, 1945, from William J. Donovan, Director of the Office of Strategic Services

candidate_claims.statement: The memorandum read in part as follows: "King Michael handed the letter to an OSS officer in Bucharest with the statement that he was pleased to have an opportunity to transmit his views to you unofficially."
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: the memorandum read in part as follows: "King Michael handed the letter to an OSS officer in Bucharest with the statement that he was pleased to have an opportunity to transmit his views to you unofficially."

candidate_claims.statement: The enclosed note of 36 pages was not printed.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: The enclosed note of 36 pages not printed.

candidate_claims.statement: The final phrase beginning "and of my most sincere …" together with the date line were handwritten by King Michael.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: The final phrase beginning "and of my most sincere …" together with the date line were handwritten by King Michael.

candidate_claims.statement: The letter includes the statement: "I am hoping that in the future Romania can faithfully wait for the happy effects and beneficial influences of a just judgment by the President of the Great United States of America."
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: I am hoping that in the future Romania can faithfully wait for the happy effects and beneficial influences of a just judgment by the President of the Great United States of America.

candidate_claims.statement: The letter contains the statement: "I am held by a painful and serious anxiety as to our future, having observed the attitude of various representatives of the U.R.S.S. in Romania, who in many cases have not at all understood our problems."
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: I am held by a painful and serious anxiety as to our future, having observed the attitude of various representatives of the U.R.S.S. in Romania, who in many cases have not at all understood our problems.
